title: bidens tenera var. paucidentata
intro: Bidens tenera var. paucidentata, commonly known as "three-toothed beggarticks," is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bidens tenera var. paucidentata include treating fever, wounds, and digestive issues, as well as alleviating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
